recognize_zh: 紅血球大小不一，許多偏小且中央淡染區擴大（低色素），並混有鉛筆狀、淚滴形、口形與少數帶刺的不規則紅血球；以右上角小淋巴球作為大小參考，符合中度缺鐵性貧血。
features: Hypochromic red cells with widened central pallor; many smaller than the lymphocyte nucleus
Moderate anisocytosis with admixed larger, better hemoglobinized cells
Poikilocytosis including elongated pencil cells, teardrop forms, slit-like pallor and occasional spiculated cells
Small mature lymphocyte (upper right) and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows hypochromic, predominantly microcytic red cells with moderate anisopoikilocytosis. Poikilocytes include pencil cells, teardrop forms and occasional spiculated cells. A small lymphocyte is present for size comparison, and platelets are adequate in this field. Findings are consistent with moderate iron deficiency anemia.

ddx.vs: Shows more uniform microcytosis (low RDW) with target cells and basophilic stippling and normal ferritin.
Features a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts in the marrow.
Is typically normocytic to mildly microcytic with minimal poikilocytosis and normal or raised ferritin.
